grammar.summary: 本课讲述中世纪「保护金」勒索与英国雇佣兵首领霍克伍德的故事，集中运用了 would 表示过去习惯性动作、if 条件句（与过去事实的搭配），以及 would rather...than... 宁愿……也不……结构。叙述中还有 used to 与 would 交替使用的过去习惯表达。

points.title: would 表示过去习惯 (Past Habit with would)
points.explanation: would + 动词原形可表示过去反复发生或习惯性的动作，常带叙述色彩。本课用 Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state 描写和平时期他惯常的勒索行为，比 used to 更具画面感。

examples.en: Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state and, after burning down a few farms, would offer to go away protection money was paid to them.
examples.cn: 霍克伍德便带领士兵进入某个城邦,纵火烧毁一两个农场,然后提出,如向他们缴纳保护金,他们便主动撤离。

examples.en: Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes who were willing to pay the high price he demanded.
examples.cn: 霍克伍德把他的士兵雇佣给愿给他出高价的君主。

points.title: 条件句与 if 从句 (Conditionals)
points.explanation: 本课用 if 引导真实条件句：If the money was not paid promptly, the gangsters would quickly put a man out of business，主句用 would 表示过去将来结果，从句用一般过去时表条件，符合主将从现（过去时态版本）的搭配。

examples.en: If the money was not paid promptly, the gangsters would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
examples.cn: 如果交款不及时,歹徒们就会很快捣毁他的商店,让他破产。

points.title: would rather...than... 宁愿……也不…… (Preferential would rather...than)
points.explanation: would rather + 动词原形 + than + 动词原形，表示「宁愿做……也不做……」，两个动词形式对等。本课霍克伍德的发现正是：人们宁愿付大笔钱，也不愿心血被毁。

examples.en: Sir John Hawkwood, made the remarkable discovery that people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters.
examples.cn: 英国人约翰·霍克伍德就有过非凡的发现：人们情愿拿出大笔的钱,也不愿毕生的心血毁于歹徒之手。

exercises.q: If the money was not paid promptly, the gangsters ______ quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
...people would rather pay large sums of money ______ have their life work destroyed by gangsters.
Hawkwood and his men ______ march into a city-state... 句中 would 表示：
